description.narrative: Genomförande av pilotprojekt för "holistisk" utveckling av långsiktiga kapitalmarknaderna i (Öst) Afrika (EAC). Helhetssyn för att övervinna hinder för lokal kapitalbildning riktad mot fattigdom orienterad finansiering som infrastruktur och bostäder. Fokus ligger på marknaderna för icke-statliga obligationer. Positiva effekter kommer också att följa för värdepappersmarknaderna i en vidare bemärk

Implementation of pilot for "holistic" development of long term capital markets in (East) Africa (EAC). Holistic approach to overcome hurdles for local capital accumulation directed at poverty oriented financing such as infrastructure and housing. Focus is placed on markets for non-government bonds. Positive effects will also follow for securities markets in a broader sense.

Swedish support to ESMID was provided for implementation of project activities until December 2011. Unused funds were transferred via an Amendment to the ESMID Agreement no.7, to the new programme "East African Community Capital Markets Development", carved out of the capital markets component of the ESMID programme. The invervention has been completed (ref. Contribution Completion 2014-10-28) but remained open as it is linked to the "new" EAC Capital Markets programme. The EAC Capital Markets programme (ref 51000106) was finalized in July 2018, whereby the ESMID contribution now can be finally closed. The quality assurance and completion of ESMID was handled by the Swedish Embassy in Nairobi, which was respoinsible for all contributions linked to Sida´s regional development cooperation for Sub-Saharan Africa, before hand-over to the Swedish embassy in Addis Abeba in August 2016.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
